Iqbal Ahmed Quraishi ----- Petitioner.
Vs.
Bangladesh represented by the Secretary, Ministry of Works, Government of the Peoples Republic of Bangladesh, Dhaka ----- Respondents.
full_judgment: That heirs a Bangladeshi citizen who after the partition of India migrated from Gazipur, India to the then East Pakistan now Bangladesh on 25.9.49 for permanent settlement since then he has been living in Bangladesh as a permanent resident and citizen with the members of his family. The petitioner obtained a certificate of domicile to that effect from the District Magistrate Dhaka on 23.5.1953. After the independence of Bangladesh, the Government confirmed him as a citizen of Bangladesh under Article 2(2) of President's Order No. 149 of 1972 and a certificate to that effect issued to the petitioner under Memo No. 651-1mn/III (IN-161/77) dated 18.4.78. He also obtained a Bangladeshi passport on 17.8.1979. The certificate of domicile, certificate of confirmation of nationality and copy of the Bangladesh Passport are annexed to the petition as Annexure A, A1 and A(2) respectively, The petitioner was allotted a piece of land measuring 1 bigha 1 chattak at plot No. CEN(D)-21, Road No. 103, Gulshan Model Town, PS Gulshan, Dhaka which was leased out to the petitioner for a period of 99 years by the Dhaka Improvement Trust for a consideration of Taka 16,206.00 on 4.4.1962. Thereafter the petitioner constructed a building thereon upon a plan approved by the Dhaka Improvement Trust under Memo No. 1660, TP dated 21.4.1964. The petitioner who was in possession and enjoyment of the said property was disposed there from in the 3rd week of December, 1971 which he recovered on 9.2.1986 when possession was restored to him by the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka after evicting the illegal occupant MA Aziz in Title Execution Case No. 91 of 1985 which arose out of Title Suit No. 459 of 1985 on a suit for declaration and khas possession. The petitioner filed the said suit on 26.2.1977 which was registered as Title Suit No. 52 of 1977 in the 4th Court of the Subordinate Judge, Dhaka, Subsequently the case was time to time transferred to different Courts and finally it was re-numbered as Title Suit No. 459 of 1985 in the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka and the said suit was decreed ex parte against the Government respondent, MA Aziz and others on 7.9.1985 declaring that the compromise decree dated 16.6.72 obtained by Mr. MA Aziz defendant No. 1 in Title Suit No. 62 of 1972 of the 1st Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka (in respect of the aforesaid property) was fraudulent, false, malafide, illegal, inoperative and void and of no legal effect and was not binding upon the plaintiff. It was further declared, "the suit property is not an abandoned property and that the plaintiff do get recovery of possession of the suit property". The said decree was executed in Title Execution Case No. 91 of 1985 on 9.2.1986 when the civil Court delivered possession of the suit property after evicting the said MA Aziz. The Government did not prefer any appeal against the said judgment but filed an application under Order 9 rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure read with section 11 of the Ordinance No. LTV of 1985 which was registered as Miscellaneous Case 1082 of 1986 but the same was dismissed for default on 30.8.87. Subsequently the Government-respondent published two lists known as 'Ka' and 'Kha' on 23.9.1986 which included the property in question as an abandoned property under schedule 'Ka'. The petitioner filed two cases which were registered as case Nos. 564 and 575 of 1987 in the Court of Settlement and the Court issued notices on the petitioner and the Government fixing the date for hearing of both the cases with a direction upon the Government to file written statement along with necessary documents and papers in support of their respective cases. The respondent- Government neither filed any written statement nor any document and paper nor made any statement.
